description: This file defines an Angular component named DashboardComponent that displays summary metrics for a dashboard interface. It interacts with an ApiService to fetch data asynchronously and manages UI state such as loading and error messages.

classes.name: DashboardComponent
classes.description: An Angular component that displays dashboard summary metrics, fetching data from a backend service and managing loading/error states.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Lifecycle hook that triggers loading of the dashboard summary when the component initializes.

methods.name: loadSummary
methods.description: Fetches dashboard summary data from the backend API and updates component state accordingly.
